svg.title: Hall of Fame: four games
svg.desc: 29 games of @tannergolden against GitHub, across Chess, Checkers, Pentago and Tic-Tac: @tannergolden won 12, GitHub 12, and 5 were drawn. Chess: 12 games, @tannergolden 5, GitHub 6, 1 drawn. Checkers: 5 games, @tannergolden 2, GitHub 2, 1 drawn. Pentago: 3 games, @tannergolden 1, GitHub 2, 0 drawn. Tic-Tac: 9 games, @tannergolden 4, GitHub 2, 3 drawn. Ranked by wins: @tannergolden with 12 wins (5 in Chess, 2 in Checkers, 1 in Pentago and 4 in Tic-Tac), @imvale with 4 wins (2 in Chess, 1 in Pentago and 1 in Tic-Tac), @tokafor with 3 wins (1 in Chess, 1 in Checkers and 1 in Pentago), @wrencastellan with 2 wins (1 in Checkers and 1 in Tic-Tac), @jhalloran with 1 win (1 in Chess).
